explainer.title: What does stack mean?
explainer.text: Stack height is the material between your foot and the ground, listed here as heel / forefoot in millimeters. A 30 mm heel / 22 mm forefoot gives an 8 mm drop—the difference. Higher stack usually means more cushioning, not necessarily softer, more stable, or better for you. Start with Intended use. Brands measure stack differently, including whether they count the insole, so small differences across brands may not be meaningful. Cushion levels in descriptions are each brand's own rating and aren't comparable across brands. Unsure? Treat stack as a description, not a target.
